Package io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.balance

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    AddonBalanceSummary
    Aggregate balance picture of one addon, computed from its scored (non-trivial) items: average power, the single strongest item's score, and how many items are OVERPOWERED (>=70).
    BalanceOverrides
    Optional, opt-in per-addon score overrides read from a bundled balance.yml at the root of the addon jar.
    BalanceScore
    An item's balance score (0-100) plus its derived BalanceTier.
    BalanceService
    Runtime entry point for balance data.
    ItemBalanceHeuristic
    Derives a starting balance score (0-100) for an item from signals it already exposes - no manual authoring required.
    ItemEffortHeuristic
    Estimates how HARD an item is to obtain (0 = trivial, 100 = maximal grind) - the "effort" axis that pairs with the authored power score.
  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    BalanceTier
    Coarse power classification of a Slimefun item, relative to vanilla Minecraft.
    BalanceVerdict
    The balance verdict for an item, derived from its power score AND its effort to obtain.
